Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-RECORD-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp number;
begin
 :s_goals.year := :ctrl_block_1.year ;
 select count(*),nvl(sum(goal_count),0) into temp, :s_goals.count from goals 
 where goal_MMYY = to_char(to_date('01-'||substr(:s_goals.month,1,3)||'-97'),'MM') 
 ||:ctrl_block_1.year and 
 goal_type = :ctrl_block_1.goal_type and

 goal_custodian = :ctrl_block_1.G_custodian;
**/

 item_change('ctrl_block_1.pb_type_lov','D');
 set_block_property('goals',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 go_block('goals');
 execute_query;
 :goals.month := :s_goals.month;
 go_item('s_goals.month');
 set_block_property('goals',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
else
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.pb_retrieve','D');
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.goal_type','D');
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.year','D');
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.g_custodian','D');

 go_item('s_goals.month');
-- show_error('11249');
-- check_package_failure;
 set_block_property('goals',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
end if;
end;

declare
 procedure format_error is
 temp_format varchar2(100);
 temp_pos number;

 temp_format := upper(GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK));
 -- remove FM or FX format prefix
 if substr(temp_format,1,2) in ('FX','FM') then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,3);
 end if;
 -- remove double quotes and change 0 to 9
 temp_format := translate(temp_format,'0"','9');
 -- change HH24 to HH
 temp_pos := instr(temp_format,'HH24');
 if temp_pos != 0 then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,temp_pos-1)||'HH'||
 substr(temp_format,temp_pos + 4);
 end if;
 -- change multiple RR to YY
 loop
 temp_pos := instr(temp_format,'RR');
 exit when temp_pos = 0;
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,temp_pos-1)||'YY'||
 substr(temp_format,temp_pos + 2);
 end loop;
 show_error('0022',temp_format );
 check_package_failure;
 end;
